title: How Well Do SAST Tools Work Across Languages? An Empirical Study Using OCPP Implementations
abstract: arXiv:2611.14362v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As electric vehicle (EV) adoption accelerates globally, securing electric vehicle charging station (EVCS) software becomes increasingly critical. The Open Charge Point Protocol (OCPP), widely adopted for EVCS management, places significant responsibility on developers to securely implement specifications that are subject to multiple interpretations. The variety of OCPP implementations across different programming languages provides a unique opportunity to evaluate security tooling in a real-world, multi-language context where implementation variability may introduce vulnerabilities. This study provides the first empirical evaluation of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tool performance across multiple programming languages using OCPP implementations as a real-world test corpus. translated_title: SAST工具在跨语言场景下表现如何？基于OCPP实现的实证研究
translated_abstract: 随着全球电动汽车（EV）普及的加速，保障电动汽车充电站（EVCS）软件的安全变得日益关键。开放充电点协议（OCPP）被广泛用于EVCS管理，由于该协议规范存在多种解读方式，开发者在安全实现规范方面承担着重大责任。OCPP实现涵盖多种编程语言，这为在真实的多语言环境中评估安全工具提供了独特机会——在这样的环境中，实现之间的差异性可能引入漏洞。本研究首次以OCPP实现作为真实世界的测试语料库，对静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具在多种编程语言下的性能进行了实证评估。我们对十二个OCPP 1.6实现应用了综合性的多语言工具（SonarQube和Semgrep）以及特定语言的分析器——每个实现均以不同的编程语言编写。
tldr: 本研究首次以十二个用不同编程语言编写的真实OCPP 1.6实现作为测试语料，实证评估了静态应用安全测试（SAST）工具在跨语言场景下的检测性能。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first empirical evaluation of Static Application Security Testing (SAST) tool performance across multiple programming languages, using twelve real-world OCPP 1.6 implementations as a test corpus.
